summaries: A Form 10-Q quarterly financial report for Harte Hanks, Inc. for the period ended March 31, 2024. Relevant to the task: The Condensed Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Loss reports "Advertising, selling, general and administrative" expenses of $5,939 thousand for the three months ended March 31, 2024. This document supplies Harte Hanks' operating and administrative expense data for the quarter required for the comparison, though it does not contain expense information for any other companies.

A Form 10-Q quarterly report for Acorda Therapeutics, Inc. covering the period ended March 31, 2024. Relevant to the task: The Consolidated Statements of Operations report Total Operating Expenses of $39,917 thousand and Selling, general and administrative expenses of $28,371 thousand for the three months ended March 31, 2024. As a single filing, this provides only Acorda's specific expense figures — not enough on its own to determine which company has the lowest.

A Form 10-Q quarterly report for Hugoton Royalty Trust covering the period ended March 31, 2024. Relevant to the task: The Condensed Statements of Distributable Income report Administration expense of $228,423 for the three months ended March 31, 2024. As a royalty trust, this expense line reflects trustee and regulatory costs rather than traditional operational expenditures, providing the specific expense figure for Hugoton necessary to compare against the operating and administrative expenses of the other companies in the collection.

A Form 10-Q quarterly report for Aspira Women’s Health Inc. covering the period ended March 31, 2024. Relevant to the task: The Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations reports Total Operating Expenses of $5,924 thousand for the three months ended March 31, 2024, broken down into Research and development ($906 thousand), Sales and marketing ($1,889 thousand), and General and administrative ($3,129 thousand). This document supplies the specific expense figures for Aspira Women’s Health Inc., providing a necessary data point for comparison against other companies in the collection to identify the lowest operating and administrative expenses.

A Form 10-Q quarterly report for Coyni, Inc. covering the period ended March 31, 2024. Relevant to the task: The Statements of Operations report General and administrative expenses of $29,526 for the three months ended March 31, 2024, with no stock compensation expense, constituting total operating expenses of $29,526. The company notes these costs are primarily professional fees for a shell entity with no revenue. As a single filing, this provides only Coyni, Inc.'s specific expense figure — not enough on its own to determine which company has the lowest.

A Form 10-Q quarterly report for Bioethics, Ltd. covering the period ended March 31, 2024. Relevant to the task: The Condensed Statements of Operations reports Total Operating Expenses of $27,221 for the three months ended March 31, 2024, composed entirely of General and administrative expenses. The MD&A describes the registrant as a shell company with no ongoing operations, noting expenses consist primarily of legal, accounting, and corporate maintenance fees. This document supplies the operating expense data for Bioethics, Ltd. required for the comparison against other companies in the collection, serving as one necessary data point to identify the lowest expenses.
